title: Decawork
description_en: Control your company's internal AI agents and tools. Decawork is how IT teams take employee-built AI agents live and control every one of them from one place. An employee builds an agent on Claude Code, Codex, or any vibecoding tool; we take it in, put it on company accounts, and run it as a company asset. From there, IT team manages the agent like an employee: access, oversight, retirement.

full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角：这是一个有趣的学术探索，但投资价值极低。①方向Alpha有限：规范驱动开发并非新概念，在AI Agent时代的适用性存疑——当前趋势是conversational coding和实时迭代，而非回归重文档的瀑布模式。②市场被低估程度：几乎没有，主流开发者正在拥抱Cursor/Copilot的轻量级交互模式。③核心风险：纯理论框架，无团队、无产品、无验证；作者信息缺失说明可能是学生作业或早期研究；即使产品化也面临OpenHands/Devin等成熟方案的碾压。④投资论文适配：完全不适配，我们寻找有执行力团队的AI-native产品，而非学术概念。唯一价值是作为行业研究参考

title: OPENBOT
description_en: Opensource alternative for Grokbot. Most agent tooling gives you a chat box that resets. title: Pruve.dev
description_en: Ask any line of code why it exists, and get receipts. AI writes the code, then throws the reasoning away at merge: the thread, the issue, the agent session. Pruve reads a repository's history and answers why any line is the way it is, with receipts you can open. No evidence, no answer. Free for open source repositories.
description_zh: Pruve.dev解决AI生成代码后上下文丢失的问题。当AI写完代码合并后，原始的讨论线程、issue、agent会话记录通常被丢弃，导致后续维护者不知道某行代码为什么这样写。Pruve通过读取代码仓库的完整历史（commits、PRs、issues等），用AI重建每行代码的决策链条，回答'为什么这行代码是这样的'，并提供可点击的证据来源。产品强调'No evidence, no answer'原则，只给出有据可查的答案。目前对开源仓库免费。这是一个典型的开发者工具，目标用户是需要理解遗留代码或AI生成代码的工程师团队。

title: The Jury
description_en: Four AI jurors rank products—never payments. The Jury is an independent product leaderboard where Claude, GPT, Gemini, and Grok review the same captured landing-page evidence.
